name: Search Operators
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Handles escaped quotes and stops queries with invalid clauses.
Opens modified result clicks in a new tab.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A query with a mistake in one part now shows the error, not results that skip that part.
Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) as you open a result to open it in a new tab.
tip: Type linksto:[[Projects/*]] to find notes that link to any note in a folder.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Search Operators is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to find things in your vault.
